main_text.p: יִקְדָּה f. Chald. Combustio: Constr. לִיקְדַּת אֶשׁ Com-bustionem ignis, Dan.7.11.
יִקְדְּתָא f. Chald. Ardens, Accensa, Dan.3.6. vel יִקְדְּתָא [?] 26. Absolutum יִקִּידָא [?].
main_text.head: יקר
main_text.p: יִקְרָ [?] Obedientia, secundum quosdam: vel Aggregatio, Collestio, Associatio: Constr. יִקְהַת־עַמִּים [?] Obedientia, vel aggregatio populorum, Gen.49. v.10. לִיקְהַת אֵם [?] Obedientiam matris, Prov.30.17. R.Levi, Associationem matris, ut scil. mater solet liberos ad se alli-cere, & in gremium associare. Scribitur autem cum Dagefch euphonico pro לִיקְהַת [?]: simile vide in יָקַר [?]. R.Salom. Radicem facit קָהָה [?] Aggregare, Congregare, & sic litera י est servilis. Probat ex usu Talmudico, קָהֲיָה [?] & קָהָה [?] יִקְהָה [?] idem per transpositum.
main_text.head: יקע
main_text.p: Pendere luxatum, Luxari, Recedere, Divelli. Praeter. יָקַע כַּף יָרֵךְ [?] וַתֵּקַע [?] Et pendebat luxatum aceta-bulum femoris, Gen.32.25. פֶּן תֵּקַע [?] נַפְשִׁי [?] Ne luxata recedat anima mea abs te, Jer.6.7. Sic Ezech.23.17.18. Hiph. הוֹקִיעַ [?] Pendere facere, Suspendere: Praeter. וְהוֹקַעְנוּם [?] Et suspendemus eos, 2.Sam.21.6. Imper. וְהוֹקַע אוֹתָם [?] Et suspende eos, Num.25.4. Hoph. Partic. עַצְמוֹת־הַמּוּקָעִים [?] Offa suspensorum, 2.Sam.21.13.
main_text.head: יקף
main_text.p: Hiph. הִקִּיף [?] Ambivit, Circumivit, Cinxit, Circumdedit, Circumegit: Praeteritum, הִקִּיף עָלַי [?] Circumegit mihi, Job.19.6. כִּי־הִקִּיפוּ [?] Cum circumegissent, Job.1.5. Futur. תָּקִּיפוּ [?] vide in נָקַף [?].
main_text.head: יקץ
main_text.p: Evigilavit, Expergefactus est: Futur. וַיִּיקַץ [?] Et evigilavi, Gen.41.21. וַיִּיקָץ [?] Et evigilavit Pharao, Gen.41.v.4. Et in Sægol propter accentum ad penult. retractum, וַיִּקֶץ [?] Et quum evigilasset Noah, Genef.9.24. Et defectivè, וַיִּקְץ [?] Et evigilavit, 1.Reg.18.27. יִקָּצוּ [?] Expergiscentur, Habac.2.7. abjecto radicali, quod Metheg compensat.
